featured_reviews.name: Bhavesh Mistry
featured_reviews.review_text:
We are beyond thrilled with the amazing experience CHOCOKATES gave us for our 10th Foundation Anniversary celebration at Rightness Personnel Solutions Pvt. Ltd.!

We had a huge challenge — celebrating a decade of success by sending cakes to our entire team and all our valued clients. And CHOCOKATES made it happen flawlessly! The cakes weren’t just delicious; they were beautifully crafted, fresh, and full of joy — perfectly adding sweetness to our milestone celebration.

A special shout-out to Priti Ma’am, the real hero behind this entire operation. Managing logistics for such a large-scale client and employee distribution could have been stressful, but she handled everything with incredible professionalism, warmth, and grace. Every cake was delivered on time, perfectly packed, and exactly as promised — it truly felt like having a world-class event coordinator on our side!

If you’re looking for not just quality cakes but a team that genuinely cares about making your celebration perfect, CHOCOKATES is the one to trust. They didn’t just deliver desserts — they delivered happiness and helped us make our 10-year journey even more memorable. 🎉🎂💛

The so called Lunchbox cake, prized at Rs. 299, was so small that it fitted in a Pastry box. I was surprised to see that how nicely some shops can fool us. But still if you're charging Rs.299 for such a pastry, you should be smart enough to atleast include a cake board beneath so that it stays away from box?! Such experiences make me never try a new cake shop! Photos will tell the rest.

Thankfully we had a bigger & "Proper" cake from another shop otherwise our occasion would've been ruined!
